name: LoP PetAI Compat
description: Optional PetAI layer for Legacy of the Phanerozoic dinosaurs. LoP's generational domestication decides when a dino is tame; PetAI then adds bonding (one hand-feed or /lopbond), naming, follow/stay/sit/lie/roar commands and follow-teleport. Requires PetAI and the LoP family mods it patches.
